title: List of equipment sets/Other
html:
This page lists various miscellaneous equipment sets.

See also: Category:Equipment sets (Other)

Absolute set

Main article: Absolute set

The Absolute set is a set of armour and equipment themed around the Cult of the Absolute. They provide bonuses to characters who bear the Brand of the Absolute.

  • Absolute's Protector: reduces damage from spells by one for users bearing the mark of the Absolute.
  • Absolute's Talisman: grants advantage on death saving throws for users bearing the mark of the Absolute.
  • Absolute's Warboard: +1 to saving throws to users bearing the mark of the Absolute.
  • Gloves of Power: inflicts Bane on a melee hit if the user bears the mark of the Absolute.
  • Ring of Absolute Force: cast Thunderwave and deal +1 Thunder damage if the user bears the mark of the Absolute.
  • Vision of the Absolute: Blind targets that fail a Dexterity saving throw. Deals an additional 2d6 Piercing to certain creatures that sport multiple sets of eyes.

Adamantine set

Main article: Adamantine set

The Adamantine set is a set of armour and equipment from the ⁠Adamantine Forge.

Craftable

Can be crafted from Mithral Ore

  • Adamantine Shield
  • Adamantine Scale Mail
  • Adamantine Splint Armour
  • Adamantine Longsword
  • Adamantine Mace
  • Adamantine Scimitar

Non-Craftable

Can be looted from  Grym

  • Grymskull Helm

Bhaalist set

Main article: Bhaalist set

The Bhaalist Set is a set of Unholy Assassin gear. These items provide the user myriad benefits, including piercing vulnerability aura, ability to use Garrotte, and inflict bleeding.

  • Amulet of Bhaal
  • Assassin of Bhaal Cowl
  • Bhaalist Armour
  • Bhaalist Gloves

Blackguard set

Main article: Blackguard set

The Blackguard equipment is a set of armour themed around Oathbreaker Paladins that grants various bonuses.

  • Blackguard's Gauntlets
  • Blackguard's Greaves
  • Blackguard's Sword
  • Blackguard's Plate
  • Shield of the Undevout

Bonespike set

Main article: Bonespike set

Bonespike is a set of equipment that provides useful bonuses for unarmoured, physical hitters such as the Barbarian class, or while Raging. They have no proficiency requirements.

  • Bonespike Boots: grants +1 to AC and saving throws while the user is not wearing armour or using a shield.
  • Bonespike Garb: grants temporary hit points while using Rage.
  • Bonespike Gloves: the wearer's attacks ignore Resistance to physical damage.
  • Bonespike Helmet: possibly deals Psychic damage to nearby creatures when the wearer uses Rage.

Cantrip set

Main article: Cantrip set

The Cantrip set enhances damaging cantrips or grants access to them. Synergizes with items from the Elemental set and Sparkstruck set, which are not duplicated here.

  • Circlet of Mental Anguish: Heal 1d4⁠⁠Hit Points when an enemy fails an INT, WIS, or CHA save from a cantrip or spell.
  • Gemini Gloves: May target an additional creature with a cantrip once per short rest.
  • Gold Wyrmling Staff: Grants access to  Fire Bolt.
  • Helldusk Gloves: May cast  Rays of Fire as a cantrip once per short rest. Gain + 1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC.
  • Hellfire Greataxe: May cast  Hellflame Cleave as a cantrip once per short rest.
  • Incandescent Staff: Grants access to  Fire Bolt. Grants + 1 spell attack bonus.
  • Moon Devotion Robe: Grants access to  Produce Flame.
  • Mourning Frost: Grants access to  Ray of Frost.
  • Potent Robe: Cantrips deal additional damage equal to your CHA mod.
  • Quickspell Gloves: May cast a cantrip as a  Bonus Action once per short rest.
  • Ring of Arcane Synergy: Dealing damage with a cantrip grants 2 stacks of  Arcane Synergy.
  • Sorrow: Grants access to  Sorrowful Lash.
  • Spellseeking Gloves: Gain access to the  Seeking Spell Metamagic.
  • Staff of a Mumbling Wizard: Grants access to  Firebolt?.

Ceremonial weapons

Main article: Ceremonial set

Ceremonial weapons are weapons used in the quest Find the Blood of Lathander. They are Uncommon versions of their respective weapon types with a +1 Enchantment and no other special effects. They also glow when placed upon the corresponding ceremonial pedestal.

  • Ceremonial Battleaxe
  • Ceremonial Longsword
  • Ceremonial Mace
  • Ceremonial Warhammer

Dark Justiciar set

Main article: Dark Justiciar set

The Dark Justiciar equipment is a set of armour themed after Shar's Dark Justiciars. Their bonuses revolve around being obscured.

Discoverable

These Dark Justiciar equipment pieces are significantly weaker but can be discovered around the world.

  • Damaged Dark Justiciar Armour
  • Dark Justiciar Gauntlets (Uncommon)
  • Dark Justiciar Half-Plate (Rare)
  • Dark Justiciar Helm
  • Dark Justiciar Helmet
  • Dark Justiciar Mail
  • Dark Justiciar Mask
  • Justiciar's Greatshield
  • Justiciar's Scimitar

Pristine

These pieces are pristine and have more powerful effects, but can only be received by becoming a Dark Justiciar.

  • Dark Justiciar Boots
  • Dark Justiciar Gauntlets (Rare)
  • Dark Justiciar Half-Plate (Very Rare)

Drunk set

Main article: Drunk set

The Drunk set includes items that interact with Alcohol mechanics.

  • Amulet of the Drunkard
  • Drunken Cloth
  • Punch-Drunk Bastard

Gish (hybrid) set

Main article: Gish (hybrid) set

The Gish (hybrid) set comprises of equipment that benefits both spellcasters and martial characters. Items that boost  Initiative, Critical hit, off-hand attacks, all attack rolls (thereby including the Sparkstruck set), and grant advantage to all attacks are part of this set, but are not duplicated here.

  • Band of the Mystic Scoundrel: May cast an illusion or enchantment spell as a bonus action after making a weapon attack.
  • Callous Glow Ring: Wearer deals an additional 2 points of Radiant damage against creatures that are illuminated.
  • Daredevil Gloves: Ranged spell attacks treated as melee when in melee, which grants larger access to melee-only items in the set.
  • Diadem of Arcane Synergy: Gain 2 stacks of  Arcane Synergy when you inflict a condition.
  • Elven Chain: Considered Proficient with this armour, thereby allowing casting while in medium armour.
  • Gauntlet of the Tyrant: Unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Force damage. Spell DC +1.
  • Gloves of Baneful Striking: Target receives -1d4 penalty on its next spell when you deal damage with a weapon attack.
  • Gloves of Battlemage's Power: Gain  Arcane Acuity when your weapon attack inflicts a condition. Bugged; doesn't work.
  • Hat of Uninhibited Kushigo: Temporarily increase spell DC by 1 after an unarmed attack.
  • Helldusk Armour: Considered Proficient with this armour, thereby allowing casting while in heavy armour.
  • Helmet of Arcane Acuity: Gain 2 stacks of  Arcane Acuity when you deal damage with a weapon attack.
  • Infernal Rapier: May attack using your spellcasting modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity.
  • Ironwood Club: Deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Bludgeoning damage when  Shillelagh is active.
  • Ironvine Shield: Deal ⁠Piercing damage when hit in melee while  Shillelagh is active.
  • Ring of Arcane Synergy: Gain 2 stacks of  Arcane Synergy when you deal damage with a cantrip.
  • Ring of Elemental Infusion: Adds elemental damage to the wearer's next weapon attack, after dealing elemental damage with a spell.
  • Sorrow: Gain access to  Sorrowful Lash.
  • Spellthief: Regain 1 spell slot once per short rest when you crit with this weapon.
  • Strange Conduit Ring: Weapon attacks deal 1d4⁠⁠Psychic damage while concentrating.
  • Sylvan Scimitar: May attack using your spellcasting modifier instead of Strength or Dexterity.
  • Thorn Blade: Weapon attacks deal 1d4⁠⁠Poison damage while concentrating.
  • Vivacious Cloak: Gain  8 temporary hit points after casting a spell in melee.

Helldusk set

Main article: Helldusk set

Helldusk armour is a set of equipment that revolves around resisting and dealing ⁠Fire damage. It is forged from Infernal Iron.

Flawed

The Flawed variants of the Helldusk set can be produced by Dammon, who apprenticed under Carixim, if he is given Infernal Iron or Infernal Alloy.

  • Flawed Helldusk Armour
  • Flawed Helldusk Gloves
  • Flawed Helldusk Helmet

Perfect

The perfect variants of the Helldusk set are originals produced by Carixim. They have more powerful effects but are harder to acquire.

  • Helldusk Armour
  • Helldusk Boots
  • Helldusk Gloves
  • Helldusk Helmet

Homing weapons

Main article: Homing weapons

Homing weapons and armour return after being Thrown.

  • Dwarven Thrower
  • Nyrulna
  • Returning Pike
  • Slinging Shoes
  • Comeback Handaxe

Kushigo set

Main article: Kushigo set

Kushigo is a set of equipment. Kushigo equipment generally boosts unarmed and unarmoured characters, such as those classed into Monk. See also Monk set, Soul set, Unarmed set, and List of features and items that interact with unarmed strikes.

  • Armour of Uninhibited Kushigo: May use a reaction to make an unarmed strike against an attacker that misses while  Patient Defence is active.
  • Boots of Uninhibited Kushigo: Unarmed attacks deal additional damage equal to your  Wisdom modifier.
  • Gloves of Uninhibited Kushigo: Deal an additional 1d4 damage with  Throw Attacks and attacks made with  Improvised Weapons.
  • Hat of Uninhibited Kushigo: Gain a +1 bonus to spell save DC until the end of your turn after making an unarmed attack.

Low HP set

Main article: Low HP set

The Low HP set is a group of equipment that benefits from having a small number of hit points and items that damage the wielder to more easily reach those low HP values. The self-burn from the Heat Set also helps lower HP. Note that  temporary hit points is not factored in to the activation conditions of these items.

  • After Death Do Us Part: Rise at half hit points when  Downed, but be cursed with  Shadow Possession.
  • Blooded Greataxe: Deal an additional 1d4⁠⁠Slashing when you have 50% hit points or less.
  • Cap of Wrath: Gain 2 stacks of  Wrath when starting a turn with 50% hit points or less.
  • Comeback Handaxe: Returns to the wielder when thrown, dealing 1d6 + 1⁠⁠Slashing damage to the thrower.
  • Glowing Shield: Gain 8  temporary hit points when you take damage while below 50% hit points once per short rest.
  • Helmet of Grit: Gain an additional  Bonus Action when starting a turn with 50% hit points or less.
  • Horns of the Berserker: Unarmed and melee weapon attacks deal an additional 2⁠⁠Necrotic damage if the wearer is not at full hp.
  • Loviatar's Scourge: Deal an additional 1d6⁠⁠Necrotic damage to nearby creatures, including yourself. Grants ⁠Necrotic Resistance.
  • Martial Exertion Gloves: May use  Martial Exertion once per short rest.
  • Moondrop Pendant: The wearer does not provoke opportunity attacks when at 50% or less hit points.
  • Nyrulna: Deals an extra 1d6⁠⁠Thunder. Deals an additional 3d4⁠⁠Thunder in a radius when thrown, possibly damaging yourself.
  • Ritual Axe: Chance to inflict  Bane on hit. Deal 1d6⁠⁠Piercing to yourself if you have 25% or more HP.
  • Ritual Dagger: May use  Blood Sacrifice once per turn.
  • Rupturing Blade: May use the  Searing Blood weapon action once per short rest.
  • Spurred Band: Gain 1 stack of  Momentum when starting a turn with 50% hit points or less.
  • The Oak Father's Embrace: Beasts that hit the wearer deal an additional 1d6⁠⁠Radiant damage.
  • The Watersparkers: Standing in water turns it into  Electrified Water, which will damage the wearer.
  • True Love's Embrace: Cast  Warding Bond on an ally wearing  True Love's Caress.
  • Viconia's Walking Fortress: Cast  Warding Bond once per long rest.

Off-hand set

Main article: Off-hand set

The off-hand set contains equipment designed to enhance weapons in the off-hand slot.

  • Bloodthirst: Gain  True Strike when a creature misses you.  Armour Class +1.
  • Cold Snap: Deal 1d4⁠⁠Cold damage on hit. Inflict Chilled when a creature misses you with an attack.
  • Crimson Mischief: Add ability modifier to off-hand damage.
  • Gleamdance Dagger: Glows.  Armour Class +1.
  • Gloves of the Balanced Hands: Add ability modifier to off-hand damage.

Relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children

Main article: Relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children

The Relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children is set of equipment with a connection to the duergar goddess Deep Duerra and the rebellion her children started in order to escape her control.

  • Cloak of Cunning Brume
  • Covert Cowl
  • Eversight Ring
  • Hammergrim Mist Amulet
  • Least Expected
  • Penumbral Armour
  • Shadow Blade Ring
  • The Shadespell Circlet

Soul set

Main article: Soul set

Soul is a set of equipment that primarily benefits those classed into Monk, with improvements to unarmed attacks. See also Kushigo set, Monk set, Unarmed set, and List of features and items that interact with unarmed strikes.

  • Gloves of Soul Catching: Unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d10⁠⁠Force damage. May heal 10⁠⁠Hit Points once per turn on an unarmed hit or gain  Advantage on Attack rolls and Saving throws until the end of your next turn.
  • Mask of Soul Perception: Gain a +2 bonus to Attack rolls, Initiative Rolls, and Perception Checks. May cast  Detect Thoughts once per short rest.
  • Vest of Soul Rejuvenation: May use a Reaction to make an Unarmed Strike Unarmed Strike against any attacker that misses.  Armour Class +2.

Unwanted set

Main article: Unwanted set

The Unwanted set is a set of masterwork armour.

  • Unwanted Masterwork Gauntlets
  • Unwanted Masterwork Greaves
  • Unwanted Masterwork Scalemail

Weave set

Main article: Weave set

The Weave Set is a set that boosts its wearer's spell-related rolls through Arcane Enchantment: gain bonus to Spell Save DC and spell attack rolls. Previously worn by wizard Tenser and Edith Cluckle.

  • Cloak of the Weave
  • Hood of the Weave
  • Robe of the Weave
